quality.reason: Well-structured, timestamped report with sourced, scored, and linked signals plus transparency about a partial scan timeout, but it leaks the prompt instruction 'Now format the Discord report:' into the output and surfaces low-engagement sources (0-2 likes) of uncertain reliability.

Well-structured status digest with quantified trading metrics and one actionable BTC signal, but marred by broken ticker tags on 2 of 3 news items, a weak signal strength (0.42), and news of questionable trading relevance.

Well-structured review with actionable per-pair strategy health signals: clear strong/weak flags, score trends vs prior week (ETH 69.6→75.96), SOL weakness warning, and margin analysis enabling concrete rebalancing decisions.

The report contains genuinely actionable signal (two correlated whales rotating into JTO with specific sizes and PnL), but the leaked LLM preamble 'Now let me format the Discord report:' is a formatting defect that should be stripped before publishing to Discord.

Well-structured report with concrete metrics, trend deltas, and genuinely actionable alerts — a crashed news-agent (-21.2, zero new items) and whale-monitor's contradictory 0% uptime despite its best-ever 92.0 score both demand investigation, though the score/uptime inconsistency hints at a scoring bug worth fixing.

Well-structured output with valuable methodology transparency (documenting API rate-limit fallback to 8 web searches and paper verification), but the leaked internal monologue ('I have enough verified data...') at the start is unpolished and the actual digest content is not visible in this excerpt to confirm substantive value.

Clear thesis with specific dates and concrete evidence (halted signals since June 29, last trade May 22, NULL evaluations) identifying a genuinely important operational issue — a dead bot with negative expected value — presented in well-structured format, though the truncated excerpt prevents full verification of the promised actionable finding.
